name: fox_click
description: Click an element found by selector (CSS), xpath, text or x+y viewport coordinates, in that order. Top document only (not inside iframes or shadow DOM); fails on a disabled element. The element is scrolled into view and receives synthetic mousedown/mouseup/click events (isTrusted=false: pages that require real user input may ignore them); doubleClick / rightClick send dblclick / contextmenu. Returns the clicked element's info. Headless: selector or x+y only.

text.description: Visible text of the element: the innermost element whose whole text contains it (case-sensitive; enabled, visible matches first). Top document only: not inside iframes or shadow DOM

name: fox_detect_captcha
description: Detect captchas on the page (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, generic image captchas). Reports what was found so the human can be asked to solve it. Does NOT auto-solve.

name: fox_evaluate
description: Run JavaScript in the tab's top frame; refused when script execution is disabled (allow_script_execution in safety.json or FOX_ALLOW_SCRIPTS=0). mode 'script': return the value of the last expression (JSON-compatible; no top-level `return`, wrap code in an IIFE); Extension path: runs in the content script's isolated world, which sees the page DOM but not the variables of the page's own scripts, and its console.log and fetch/XHR are not captured by fox_logging; headless: runs in the page's own world. mode 'chain': evaluate steps in order, each receiving the prior result as `$prev`, console output captured per step. mode 'wait_and_act': poll until condition is truthy, then run actionScript and return its result. chain and wait_and_act are headless only (the Extension path returns an error).

captureConsole.description: Capture console output for this step

stopOnError.description: Abort chain if this step throws

steps.description: (mode=chain; required) Ordered list of JS expressions to evaluate. Each step receives the prior result as `$prev`.

condition.description: (mode=wait_and_act; required) JS expression that returns truthy when ready

actionScript.description: (mode=wait_and_act; required) JS to run once condition is met

pollIntervalMs.description: (mode=wait_and_act; default 200) How often to check condition

timeout.description: (mode=wait_and_act; default 15000) Max wait time in ms before giving up (at most 580000)

name: fox_find
description: Find in the page. by 'selector': elements matching a CSS selector (the first `limit`, plus the total count), each with tag, id, classes, name, type, text (200 chars), value (passwords masked), href, src, placeholder, ariaLabel, role, disabled, checked, visible, viewport position (incl. centerX/centerY) and a generated selector; headless: tag, text and box only, at most 50. by 'text': count matches of `text` with Firefox's browser.find (all frames, also outside the viewport), optionally with rects; `text` is the words to search for, not an element locator as in fox_click.

selector.description: (by=selector; required) CSS selector to find elements

text.description: (by=text; required) Text to search for in the page

entireWord.description: (by=text; default false) Match entire words only

includeRectData.description: (by=text; default false) Include bounding rect data for matches

name: fox_get_logs
description: Return what fox_logging captured on this tab (the latest `limit`); paused while the tab is on a protected site; not supported in headless mode. kind 'console': top-frame calls to console.log/warn/error/info/debug, filtered by level and/or a case-insensitive search text; not uncaught exceptions, browser errors, iframes or console output of fox_evaluate; currentPageReached=false means the current page could not be asked for its latest entries. kind 'network': fetch/XHR requests filtered by URL regex, method, status or errorsOnly (network error or status >= 400); no images, scripts, CSS or WebSocket traffic; authorization, cookie, API-key and token headers and secret fields in URLs and bodies are masked, other headers and bodies (truncated) are returned as recorded.

limit.description: (default 100) Maximum number of logs to return

urlPattern.description: (kind=network) Only requests whose URL matches this regex. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

method.description: (kind=network) Filter by HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)

errorsOnly.description: (kind=network; default false) Only return failed requests

name: fox_handle_dialog
description: Extension path: not implemented (returns an error; commands to a tab showing an alert/confirm/prompt time out there). Headless only: wait for the next dialog and accept or dismiss it (promptText for prompts). Call it before the action that opens the dialog: it does not block other commands, and when no dialog comes within timeout it arms itself for the next dialog on the tab (30 s). Dialogs nobody handles are dismissed automatically after 2 s and reported in the next result of that tab.

action.description: Whether to accept or dismiss the dialog

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog before accepting

name: fox_interact
description: Change UI state only, never page data (allowed in read-only mode). action 'hover': dispatch synthetic mouseenter / mouseover events on the element (isTrusted=false: JavaScript hover handlers run, CSS :hover styles do not apply). action 'scroll': scroll the page or the element `selector` by direction and amount, or scroll the element toElement into view. action 'highlight': show a colored overlay (and optional label) on the element for visual debugging.

selector.description: (required for hover|highlight) CSS selector for the element

toElement.description: (action=scroll) CSS selector of element to scroll into view

label.description: (action=highlight) Label to show above the element

name: fox_logging
description: Control console and fetch/XHR capture of the tab (top frame); read the logs with fox_get_logs. action 'start': start capturing (before the actions to monitor); logs are kept per tab across reloads and navigations (the newest 500 console and 500 network entries) until cleared or the tab is closed; refused on a protected site unless approved, and recording pauses while the tab is on one. action 'stop': stop capturing; the logs are kept. action 'clear': clear the console and/or network logs. Not supported in headless mode.

clearExisting.description: (action=start; default false) Clear any existing logs before starting

name: fox_navigate
description: Navigate in the browser. Actions: 'goto' (open a URL), 'back' / 'forward' (history navigation), 'refresh' (reload page), 'hard_refresh' (bypass cache, like Ctrl+Shift+R). goto / refresh with waitForLoad, and back / forward always, fail when the page does not finish loading within 25 s or the tab is closed (the navigation itself may still complete).

url.description: URL to navigate to (required for goto; not allowed with the other actions)

newTab.description: Open URL in new tab (for goto)

waitForLoad.description: Wait for page to fully load

name: fox_observer
description: Watch DOM changes. Requires script execution enabled. action 'inject': start a MutationObserver on an element (default body) that collects attribute, child list and subtree changes; it ends when the page reloads or navigates; headless: one observer per page (a new call replaces it, observerId is ignored), changes collect in window.__fox_mutations. action 'remove': remove the observer observerId and return the changes it collected (the last 100); fails when no such observer exists on the current page; headless: observerId is ignored and only the number of changes is returned.

observerId.description: (required for remove) ID for this observer (to remove it later)

observeChildList.description: (action=inject; default true) Observe child list changes

name: fox_press_key
description: Press a keyboard key with optional modifiers (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta) on the element located by selector (CSS), xpath, text or id (checked in that order; it is focused first), else on the focused element. The key events are synthetic (isTrusted=false): page handlers see them, but the browser performs no default action (no focus move on Tab, no scrolling, no browser shortcuts). Plain Enter in a form field submits the form like a real Enter. Headless: selector only; real key presses, so on a password field keys that could change its value are refused (Enter, Tab, Escape, arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and lone modifiers are allowed).

text.description: Visible text of the element: the innermost element whose whole text contains it (case-sensitive; enabled, visible matches first). Top document only: not inside iframes or shadow DOM

name: fox_read
description: Read the page. mode 'info': URL, title, document/viewport size, scroll position, up to 100 visible interactive elements (tag, type, id, name, text, href, value, placeholder, ariaLabel, center position, generated selector), forms with their first 20 fields, h1-h3 headings; password values masked; headless: URL and title only. mode 'text': visible text of the page or of the element `selector`, cheaper than a screenshot.

mode.description: What to read: 'info' (page overview) or 'text' (visible text)

selector.description: (mode=text) CSS selector; defaults to the whole page body

maxLength.description: (mode=text; default 20000) Truncate returned text to this many characters

name: fox_request_approval
description: Ask the human at the browser a yes/no question and wait for the answer. Shown in the KitsuneMCP toolbar popup in Firefox (badge + OS notification), never in the page. The answer is for you only: it does not unlock protected-site actions — those ask the human on their own when you call the tool. Unavailable in headless mode.

message.description: What you are asking permission to do, in plain language

detail.description: Optional extra context shown in smaller text

name: fox_safety_status
description: Show the active safety guard policy: read-only mode, script toggle, protected/blocked/allowed URL patterns, rate-limit state, and audit log location.

name: fox_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot. Images are saved to files and returned as resource_link, never as base64 (saveToFile=false captures nothing, includeData has no effect, the same filename overwrites the file). scope: viewport (visible area; a background tab given by tabId is captured without switching to it; a discarded tab fails), full_page (entire page; falls back to the visible area with fullPageCaptured=false), all_tabs (every tab, or those whose URL matches the urlPattern regex, within the timeout budget; tabs on protected sites are skipped; fails when no tab could be captured), scroll_capture (takes NO images: scrolls and returns the interactive elements visible at each position). Headless: viewport and full_page only.

scope.description: Capture scope: viewport (default), full_page, all_tabs, or scroll_capture

saveToFile.description: Save the image to a file and return it as a resource_link (default). Images are never returned inline, so false captures nothing and only returns the tab info (headless: ignored, always saved)

urlPattern.description: all_tabs: only tabs whose URL matches this regex. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

includeData.description: No effect: base64 image data is never returned; all_tabs images are saved to files like the others

timeout.description: all_tabs: time budget for capturing all tabs in ms (default 20000); tabs left when it runs out are reported as skipped

scrollStep.description: Pixels to scroll each step (default: 80% of viewport)

delay.description: Delay between scrolls in ms (for scroll_capture scope)

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll steps (for scroll_capture scope)

restore.description: Restore original scroll position after capture

name: fox_set_value
description: Set a form value directly (no key events), then dispatch input and change events; password fields are refused. kind 'input' (default): the value of an input, textarea, select or contenteditable element; faster than fox_type for long values; reports success even when nothing changed (an element of another kind, or a select without an option of that value). kind 'select': choose an option of a select element by option value, text or index.

selector.description: (required) CSS selector for the input element

option.description: (kind=select; required) The option to select: exactly one of value, text or index

name: fox_snapshot
description: Extension path: not implemented (returns an error); use fox_read or fox_find there. Headless: the accessibility tree of the page (or of the first element matching selector) as indented YAML text (Playwright ariaSnapshot), filtered by maxDepth, includeText and roles, cut at 50000 characters.

selector.description: CSS selector to snapshot a subtree (defaults to full page)

includeText.description: Include text content in snapshot nodes

name: fox_tab
description: Open, close or switch tabs. action 'create': open a new tab (url, default about:blank; active); with `container` the tab opens in a Firefox container (by name, created if not found, or by cookieStoreId, which must exist; isolated cookies/storage; url required; with container scope enabled in safety.json only the agent container is allowed; not available in headless mode). action 'close': close the tab tabId. action 'switch': focus/activate the tab tabId.

url.description: (action=create) URL to open in the new tab (default 'about:blank'; required with container)

active.description: (action=create; default true) Make the new tab active

name.description: Container name to use (created if not found)

cookieStoreId.description: cookieStoreId of an existing container (e.g. "firefox-container-1", as listed by fox_tabs what=containers). Takes precedence over name

container.description: (action=create) Open the tab in this Firefox container

tabId.description: (action=close|switch; required) ID of the tab to close

name: fox_tabs
description: List tabs or containers. what 'tabs': id, url, title, active, windowId, pinned, status, audible, plus totals; by default the current window and at most 50 tabs (currentWindowOnly=false for all windows; urlPattern filters before limit; includeFavicon adds favicon URLs); headless: id, url, title and active only, arguments ignored. what 'containers': Firefox containers (name, color, icon, cookieStoreId), only the agent container when container scope is enabled in safety.json; not available in headless mode.

currentWindowOnly.description: (what=tabs; default true) Only list tabs in the current window

urlPattern.description: (what=tabs) Only tabs whose URL matches this regex, before applying limit. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

includeFavicon.description: (what=tabs; default false) Include favIconUrl per tab

name: fox_type
description: Type text into an input, textarea or contenteditable element found by selector, id, name or placeholder (in that order), else into the focused field; `text` is never used to find the element. Fails on a disabled element; password fields are refused. Sends synthetic key events (isTrusted=false) `delay` ms apart (0 = none; shortened so that all delays stay within 10 s); fox_set_value is faster for long values. clear empties the field first; pressEnter also submits the form like a real Enter unless a keydown handler cancels it. Headless: selector, text and clear only (with selector the text is appended unless clear, else the focused element receives the keys).

text.description: Text to type (never used to find the element)

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element

placeholder.description: Placeholder text to find the input

pressEnter.description: Press Enter after typing. In a form field this also submits the form the way a real Enter does (unless a keydown handler cancels it); the result reports it in `enter`

delay.description: Delay between keystrokes in ms (0 = none). Reduced automatically so that all delays together stay within 10 s

name: fox_wait
description: Wait for a page condition; fails after timeout (ms). for 'element': an element matching selector appears (and is visible, unless visible=false). for 'network_idle': the page's own top-frame fetch/XHR requests have been idle for idleTime ms; requests made by fox_evaluate, and those in flight before the first call on the page, are not seen; headless: Playwright networkidle, idleTime ignored. for 'navigation': the tab's next top-level navigation finishes (waitUntil load or domcontentloaded; optionally only one matching urlPattern); a navigation that finished before the call is missed, so prefer for 'url' when the destination is known; headless: urlPattern ignored. for 'url': the URL equals url or matches the urlPattern regex (one of them required); returns at once if it already does.

selector.description: (for=element; required) CSS selector for the element

visible.description: (for=element; default true) Wait for element to be visible

idleTime.description: (for=network_idle; default 500) How long network must be idle (ms)

waitUntil.description: (for=navigation; default 'load') When to consider navigation complete

urlPattern.description: (for=navigation|url) Regex the URL of the navigation must match (other navigations are skipped). JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.
